description: This Java class 'MidiEventScheduler' extends 'EventScheduler' and manages MIDI events scheduling, including pooling of events for performance optimization, and provides a MidiReceiver for handling MIDI message transmission.

classes.name: MidiEventScheduler
classes.description: A class that schedules MIDI events and manages a pool of events for performance.

classes.name: MidiEvent
classes.description: Represents a scheduled MIDI event containing message data and timestamp.

methods.name: createScheduledEvent
methods.description: Creates a new MidiEvent, reusing from pool if possible.

methods.name: addEventToPool
methods.description: Returns a MidiEvent to the pool for reuse.

methods.name: getReceiver
methods.description: Returns the MidiReceiver instance used for MIDI message handling.
